2608.23327.title: Flesch-Kincaid Readability Depends Only on the Topic Distribution in Long Texts under Topic Models
2608.23327.paper_summary: Flesch Reading Ease (FRE) and the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL) are widely used readability scores for English computed from the same two document statistics, yet their stability on long documents need not imply invariance to lexical composition. Surprisingly, under a topic model with an explicit sentence-boundary token, both scores converge almost surely to deterministic functions of the document topic distribution through just two scalar rates: in the long-text limit, all score variation is mediated by topical composition rather than any residual readability signal. The theory covers both formulae, while the experiments evaluate FKGL. In a fixed admixture with rank[1, q, s] = 3, fibres through interior topic vectors are locally (K-3)-dimensional, whereas regular iso-score level sets are locally (K-2)-dimensional and curved. In out-of-fold evaluation on two balanced corpora, Brown and the written BNC, a topic vector inferred from one document half's content words predicts the other half's FKGL at r = 0.779 and 0.884, respectively. On Brown, adding the topic prediction to genre and mean content-word syllable count yields $ΔR^2$ = 0.002, with a confidence interval spanning zero; on the BNC, the corresponding split-half increment is 0.024, positive in four of five K = 100 fits (median 0.021). Because inferred topics may also absorb genre, register, and style, we do not interpret these results as evidence about human readability or causal effects.
2608.23327.paper_summary_zh: Flesch 閱讀易讀性 (FRE) 和 Flesch-Kincaid 年級水平 (FKGL) 是廣泛使用的英語可讀性評分，這兩個評分是基於相同的兩個文檔統計數據計算而來，然而它們在長文檔上的穩定性並不意味著對詞彙組成的不變性。令人驚訝的是，在一個具有明確句子邊界標記的主題模型下，這兩個評分幾乎肯定會收斂到文檔主題分佈的確定性函數，僅通過兩個標量速率：在長文本極限下，所有評分變化都是由主題組成所介導，而不是任何殘餘的可讀性信號。該理論涵蓋了這兩個公式，而實驗則評估了 FKGL。在固定的混合中，秩 [1, q, s] = 3，通過內部主題向量的纖維在局部是 (K-3) 維的，而常規等評分水平集在局部是 (K-2) 維的並且是曲線的。在對兩個平衡語料庫的摺疊外評估中，布朗語料庫和書面 BNC，從一個文檔一半的內容詞推斷出的主題向量預測了另一半的 FKGL，分別為 r = 0.779 和 0.884。在布朗語料庫中，將主題預測添加到類型和平均內容詞音節數中，得到 $ΔR^2$ = 0.002，置信區間跨越零；在 BNC 中，相應的分半增量為 0.024，在五個 K = 100 的擬合中有四個是正的（中位數 0.021）。由於推斷的主題也可能吸收類型、註冊和風格，我們不將這些結果解釋為有關人類可讀性或因果效應的證據。
